title: Remove Google Play Services dependency
symptom: The user wants to remove the Google Play Services dependency from xDrip+ because they don't want Google to collect their data and they don't understand why it is required, especially since they don't use Wear OS and the notification is already persistent.
cause: xDrip+ follower mode, when enabled, uses Google Messaging. The sync feature (xDrip+ Sync Follower) depends on Google Play Services.
fix: xDrip can run without Google Play Services installed. The option 'Disable all sync features' in 'xDrip+ sync settings' can permanently disable the subsystem from being initialized, which stops the pop-ups while still allowing other features like Dex share follower and Nightscout upload to work.
evidence_quote: There is also the option `Disable all sync features` in `xDrip+ sync settings` which should permanently disable this subsystem from being initialized, which might also help if you are getting issues.
